title: Latency sampling + ownership slate (ad-hoc)
content:
Purpose:
Quick sample of production endpoint latencies (one-off) to allocate ownership and list immediate follow-ups. Not exhaustive — used to coordinate a 30-min sync on 2027-07-15. Keep this doc as the ephemeral source for action items.

TABLE (columns): Area | Endpoint | Sample window (UTC) | p50(ms) | p95(ms) | p99(ms) | sample_size | Observed behavior | Assigned owner | Priority | Action / next step | Blockers / deps | Notes

Rows:
Serving runtime | /v1/generate (hosted-us-west) | 2027-07-11 14:30-15:00 | 48 | 210 | 620 | 420 | Intermittent p99 spikes correlated with long sequences + burst batching | Marco Silva | P0 | Short-term: pin batch-config to conservative for next 24h; Mid-term: add per-seq-length routing rule | config rollout risk (Dedicated burst rules) | spikes appear after 300 token responses; reproduce with seq=512 in load test
Serving runtime | /v1/embeddings (hosted-eu-central) | 2027-07-12 09:00-09:30 | 22 | 58 | 140 | 1800 | Stable except sustained p95 during index rebuild window | Priya Narang | P1 | Coordinate with infra to avoid index rebuild overlap; add alert runbook | infra maintenance schedule | embedding requests were batched heavily by client (single-key clients)
API Gateway | /v1/chat (edge-proxy) | 2027-07-13 02:00-02:30 | 32 | 190 | 900 | 60 | Rare ~1% requests timed out (gateway 502) during roll-forward of edge-proxy | Jordan Patel | P0 | Roll back proxy image used in the 01:45 deploy; create canary with 1% of traffic | deploy rollback perms | 502s show up in gateway logs with upstream reset
Client SDK | streaming websocket | 2027-07-13 17:00-17:30 | 16 | 40 | 80 | 240 | Mostly fine; single client reported repeated reconnects | Elena Chen | P2 | Reach out to the app team to capture client logs; add brief guide for reconnect backoff | app team availability | likely client-side backoff bug
Private deployment | internal-vpc /v1/generate | 2027-07-14 11:00-11:30 | 95 | 310 | 1300 | 30 | High p99 on single-tenant customer (dedicated GPUs) | Marco Silva | P0 | Schedule short-call w/SE + infra to check GPU saturation and kernel selection; propose temporary quota to reduce concurrency | customer access window | customer running large batch job concurrently

Quick Observations (freeform):
- p99 spikes tend to cluster around deploy windows and long sequence workloads. Not always CPU bound; sometimes network resets at proxy level.
- Small sample sizes for private deployment case (30) but consistent with customer complaint this morning. Treat as high-touch.
- Several items are operational (rollbacks, canary configs) vs product (batching policy). Owner assignment aims to split those.

Action tracker (short):
1) Marco: pin /v1/generate batching config -> create rollback-safe PR by 2027-07-15 10:00. (status: in progress)
2) Jordan: rollback edge-proxy image + re-canary -> target 2027-07-15 09:00. (status: in progress)
3) Priya: add index-rebuild guard to embeddings maintenance calendar -> by 2027-07-16. (status: todo)
4) Elena: assemble client logs and draft reconnect guidance -> by 2027-07-16 12:00. (status: todo)
5) Marco + SE: private customer triage call -> schedule today 16:00 PT; require customer GPU metrics. (status: scheduled)

Open questions / decisions needed:
- Do we enforce a hard limit on sequence length for hosted baseline customers? Pros: reduces p99 volatility. Cons: customer UX hit. Quick decision required for next 48h for mitigation. (Owner: product-hosted-api)
- Should we add an automated rule to pause index rebuilds when p95 for embeddings > 50ms? (Owner: infra/observability)

Meeting notes snippet (2027-07-14 sync):
- Agreed temporary conservative batching for /v1/generate for 24h; evaluate impact on unit cost and latency.
- Edge-proxy rollback cleared transient 502s in canary; full rollout paused pending deeper root cause.
- SE to get GPU perf metrics; if saturation confirmed, propose short-term concurrency throttle for that customer.

Hand-off checklist (if unresolved after 48h):
- Compile minimal reproduction script for each endpoint showing p99 spike (attach to ticket)
- Add sample logs (gateway, runtime, kernel) to ENG-4821
- Escalate to SRE on call if rollouts risk multiple customers

Notes to self / scribbles:
- slack: #eng-serving-runtime thread: "latency-sample-2027-07" (post initial findings)
- keep doc ephemeral but push final actions to ops-hotlist if any P0 remains after 72h
- prefer parallel low-risk mitigations (canary/rollback) over big config flips

This doc is intentionally lightweight: use it to coordinate owners and short actions, not as the canonical postmortem. Move artifacts into Confluence/ENG ticket when we have reproducible failures.
